graders.name: codex-user-invoked
graders.description: Convention check, not scored: when the skill has a Codex policy file, Codex treats it as user-invoked.

graders.name: instructions-intact
graders.criteria: Judge `skills/standup/SKILL.md`. It preserves the user's three requests: summarize what the user merged yesterday from git log; list open PRs they are reviewing with `gh pr list --search review-requested:@me` (quoting the search term is fine); draft three standup bullets. Added detail must not change whose work is summarized, widen the time interval, or invent plans or blockers that the gathered data does not support.

graders.name: keeps-gh-command
graders.description: The user's exact gh command survives.

graders.name: name-matches
graders.description: The frontmatter name matches the directory.

graders.name: skill-file-exists
graders.description: The skill file exists where the user asked.

graders.name: user-invoked
graders.description: Convention check, not scored: Claude Code treats it as a user-invoked slash command.
